# Getting help with VIKI Agent

Start with [Getting started](../docs/getting-started.md) for installation and setup, or
[Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md) for errors. [Known issues](../docs/known-issues.md)
lists limits you may run into. The [README](../README.md) links to the rest of the guides.

## Issues and questions

Search this repository's existing issues, then choose the form that fits:

- **Bug report:** a crash, incorrect result, or other problem you can reproduce.
- **Setup or installation help:** trouble installing, starting, or configuring the app.
- **Feature request:** a task you want the app to support or an improvement to an existing task.

Include the VIKI Agent version or commit, operating system, and steps that reproduce the problem
with sample files. If the app cannot start, give the installer filename or source commit.

For diagnostics, follow [Sharing a diagnostics report](../docs/troubleshooting.md#sharing-a-diagnostics-report).
Inspect any excerpt or screenshot before sharing it. Remove tokens, API keys, private paths,
notes and conversation content. Do not attach vaults, app databases or provider configuration files.

## Security reports and contributions

For a suspected vulnerability, follow the [security reporting policy](SECURITY.md) before sharing
details. For code or documentation changes, read [Contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md), including
the contribution agreement.
